verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish a developer API portal, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only that both mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in return HTTP 403 at robots.txt, and nothing beyond that was fetched. There is no evidence of any API reference, interactive or otherwise, or of runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
